title: A Glasshouse for the Radiators
author: Ulyana Dunmore
blurb: Sebastian Coldharbour, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
